decisions.decision: Put out another Invitation to Bid for manhole replacement on Prospect Street near Laurel Lane; have CTE assess timeline; line with epoxy to extend life
decisions.quote: bill replied no as it was already on the repair list and suggested putting out another invitation to bid to replace that one manhole. at the same time, they could line it with the epoxy so hopefully it would last longer. bill added they have time to address it, but will have cte look at it, to see how much time they have.

decisions.decision: Put together new CTE contract and aim to put it out to bid by July 8 for placement by August 27
decisions.quote: he has put a new contract together with the goal of putting it out to bid by july 8th, so they can have it place for 8/27.

decisions.decision: Put out contract language for replacing 3 pressure lines from manhole to property line at 100 Laurel Lane through procurement, to go out for bid by July 8
decisions.quote: bill reported he is putting out contract language for replacing 3 pressure lines from the manhole to the property line. it is going through procurement at town hall and will also go out for bid by 7/8.

decisions.decision: Look at change to by-laws regarding duplex connections; Bill and Andrew will write up language and have Town Counsel review; will discuss at next meeting
decisions.quote: the commission agreed to look at a change to the by-laws and discussed what it would take to make a change. bill and andrew will write up the language and have town counsel look at it.
